statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a history of cerebral infarction
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying cardiac activity
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, G45.9, and R00.2 were billed
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
